card.name: Oral dosage-form words and preparation
card.fires_on: Words naming how a medicine is taken or prepared, such as granules, sprinkle, oral suspension, orally disintegrating, swallow and reconstitute. It fires on the word or the partial word that names the form or its handling.

modes.label: Dosage form names
modes.description: Partway through or just after words naming oral forms like granules, oral solution, suspension, and disintegrating tablets.

modes.description: Inside verbs for preparing or swallowing doses, such as reconstitute, swallow, and the SPRINKLE brand suffix.
